title: Kerala High Court directs State to release ex gratia payment to victims of Wayanad Kalladi landslide
description: The Kerala High Court on Friday directed the State government to immediately disburse the ex-gratia compensation to the victims of the recent landslide at Kalladi in Wayanad [In Re: Prevention and Management of Natural Disasters in Kerala vs State of Kerala].
